/bin/sh -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect(\"inventory.db\")

    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL
)
\"\"\")
connection.commit()
print(\"\\n\".join(row[0] for row in connection.execute(\"EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT * FROM products\")))

connection.close()
PY"
